_meta.scope: Two layers, never mixed in one hierarchy. WAKING layer (layer:"waking"): the small, real Oxford/Thames-valley frame (bank, field, hedge, river backwater, farm, family house) that opens and closes the film, per bible/world.json frame.* and bible/cultivation.json SUP-001. DREAM layer (layer:"dream"): every Wonderland place, none of them a real, persistent, mappable location -- each carries a `grows_from` pointer to the waking-world detail it is built from, per bible/world.json wonderland_real_counterparts and the SUP-* registry (read-only, owner 02-worldbuilding/magic-cultivation). Production scenes (SCN-*) live in scenes/ and anchor to LOC-* via location_ref; dream-layer LOC-* are used with space_class: non_diegetic_mental per bible/WRITE_RULES.md section 4.

locations[].grows_from: {counterpart_key:<world.json wonderland_real_counterparts key|null>, loc:<LOC-*|null>, note:''}|null (null only for layer:waking entries)

_meta.extra_fields_note: Fields beyond the original skeleton example, added for this task's requirements without removing any required field: `layer` (waking|dream, required per H1 ruling 5.2 A), `grows_from` (the dream->waking link required by the ruling; null only on waking entries), top-level `spatial_relations[]` (real, waking-layer direction/travel only -- dream places get no fabricated real-world distances), and top-level `cross_domain_assumptions[]`. `deprecated: true` marks retired entries (never recycled, per work-order instruction); their `parent`/`adjacent` are cleared to avoid dangling references but original content is kept for audit.
_meta.dream_geometry_rule: Per SUP-013 and cross_domain_assumptions XA-magic-04 (cultivation.json, read-only): dream places are not persistent, mappable, or interconnected the way real places are. LOC-hall-of-doors in particular carries NO `adjacent` entries and appears in NO spatial_relations -- it is 'never re-established... connecting it to the rest of the dream's geography' (SUP-013). Other dream entries may list `adjacent` only to express the dream's own one-way narrative sequence (the order Alice moves through it), never a real, revisitable route; no `travel`/distance claims are made for dream adjacency, and dream entries are excluded from `spatial_relations[]` entirely.

cross_domain_assumptions.assumption: Every Wonderland LOC-* is now tagged layer:"dream" with a grows_from pointer to a real waking-world detail, and carries no persistent real-world parent, estate ownership or plumbing (H1 ruling 5.2 A). LOC-hall-of-doors carries no adjacency to anything outside its own three-piece set (SUP-013). The pool of tears is the flooded hall itself (SUP-007; ch002-p07), not a separate ground-level pond. LOC-estuary-shore grows from Alice's one real seaside trip (LOC-seaside-town), not from a tidal estuary of the Oxford Thames (SUP-010; DEF-p2-bible-002 -- the Thames is not tidal at Oxford). Deprecated: LOC-manor-grounds, LOC-cellar-passage, LOC-tree-hatch, LOC-village (IDs retained, never recycled). The five geo-xda-01..05 assumptions in the prior draft are RESOLVED/SUPERSEDED by this fix; they no longer apply.
